title: A beetle with eyes
question: Does this beetle read as an animal that has *noticed* something, or just one that is wandering? It is 37 cells from the ants at the start and facing away from them.
context_md:
**Beetles could never find prey.** Until tonight nothing in the engine reported another animal at a distance at all — food is sensed in the 8 cells around the head, and the only long-range senses are the ants' own scent trails, which a beetle does not lay. A beetle could always *kill*; it could never *search*, which is why nine beetles and no beetles ran bit-identical.

It can now see about 60 cells in every direction, over the litter on the floor but not through rock or soil, and only things it could actually eat.

**One thing I could not settle by measuring, and it is the reason for this card.** How hard it should chase. Turning harder makes it end up closer to what it sees (15.2 → 9.1 cells) and catch more (302 → 355 over 8 worlds) — but in a narrow corridor the harder-chasing beetle got *worse* at finishing the kill. The shipped animal takes the gentle setting. If this looks too casual to you, that is the number to move.
